'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[Myanmar|Burmese]] [[State Counsellor of Myanmar|State Counsellor]] [[Aung San Suu Kyi]] is placed under [[house arrest]] in the capital [[Naypyidaw]] after the military [[Coup d'état|coup]] that overthrew her [[politics of Myanmar|government]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/98f9dab3-4818-4d74-89de-d026aa57a651 (''Financial Times'')]
*[[Tigray War]]
**Three [[politics of Ethiopia|Ethiopian]] opposition parties say that at least 52,000 civilians have died in [[Tigray Region|Tigray]]. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-02-02/ethiopian-opposition-claims-52-000-dead-in-northern-conflict (Bloomberg)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]], [[American Rescue Plan Act of 2021|American Rescue Plan]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes 50–49 to pass a [[budget resolution]] that would allow [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democrats]] to pass [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]'s [[United States dollar|$]]1.9 trillion [[American Rescue Plan|relief package]] without support from [[Republican Party (United States)|Republicans]]. [https://www.businessinsider.com/stimulus-senate-democrats-biden-rescue-plan-without-gop-votes-2021-2 (''Business Insider'')]
*[[Amazon (company)|Amazon]] founder [[Jeff Bezos]] announces that he will step down as [[CEO]] during the third quarter. Current [[Amazon Web Services]] CEO [[Andy Jassy]] is expected to replace him. [https://www.cnbc.com/2021/02/02/jeff-bezos-to-step-down-as-amazon-ceo-andy-jassy-to-take-over-in-q3.html (CNBC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Fourteen people are killed and twelve others are injured after a coach overturned at a sharp turn near [[Uthal]], [[Pakistan]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1605203/14-killed-in-highway-tragedy-near-uthal (Dawn)] 

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Kingdom]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in England]]
*****[[Captain Tom]], a [[British Army]] veteran who served in [[World War II]] and who donated to charities during the lockdown, dies from [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]] at the age of 100. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2021/feb/02/captain-sir-tom-moore-dies-at-100-after-testing-positive-for-covid (''The Guardian'')] 
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Scotland]]
*****[[First Minister of Scotland|First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] announces a phased return to school for [[Scotland]]'s youngest children, with nurseries and all primary pupils from P1 to P3 planned to be back in the classroom beginning on February 22. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-scotland-55904466 (BBC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Spain]]
****[[Spain]] will restrict travel to [[South Africa]] and [[Brazil]] due to concerns about [[Variants of SARS-CoV-2|new variants]] of [[Severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2|SARS-CoV-2]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-spain-travel-idUSL8N2K83QF (Reuters)] 
****Spain reports 724 deaths in the past 24 hours, the most since April. [https://elpais.com/sociedad/2021-02-02/la-cifra-diaria-de-fallecidos-se-dispara-hasta-724-record-desde-la-primera-ola.html (''El País'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Andorra]]
****[[Andorra]] surpasses the 10.000 COVID-19 cases. [https://www.diariandorra.ad/noticies/nacional/2021/02/02/l_uci_puja_pacients_cedre_queda_sense_malalts_covid_174217_1125.html (''Diari d'Andorra'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****The [[France|French]] National Authority for Health approves the use of the [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford-AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] for people aged under 65. [https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210202-french-health-authorities-approve-astrazeneca-covid-19-vaccine-for-those-under-65 (France 24)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Republic of Ireland]]
****[[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] reports a record 101 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 3,418. [https://www.irishtimes.com/news/ireland/irish-news/coronavirus-101-more-deaths-in-highest-toll-recorded-on-one-day-1.4474243 (''The Irish Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]], [[COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns]]
****[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] extends all of the [[Netherlands|country]]'s tough lockdown measures for at least a month due to the spread of more transmissible variants of SARS-CoV-2. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/dutch-virus-infections-fall-20-variants-gain-strongly-75633938 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in San Marino]]
****Former [[Captains Regent|Captain Regent]] [[Fausta Morganti]] dies from COVID-19 at the age of 76. [https://www.corriereromagna.it/addio-a-fausta-morganti-bandiera-della-sinistra-sammarinese/ (''Corriere Romagna'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in North America]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Canada]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in New Brunswick]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[New Brunswick]] reports its first two cases of the UK variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.thestar.com/news/canada/2021/02/02/uk-variant-confirmed-in-new-brunswick-as-25-new-covid-19-cases-reported-tuesday.html (''Toronto Star'')]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Saskatchewan]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
*****[[Saskatchewan]] reports its first two cases of the B.1.1.7 variant of SARS-CoV-2 in the [[Regina, Saskatchewan|Regina]] area. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/saskatchewan/covid-19-in-sask-tuesday-u-k-variant-detected-1.5897916 (CBC)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Mexico]]
****[[Mexico]] approves the use of [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] vaccine in the country. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/health/coronavirus/russia-s-coronavirus-vaccine-approved-for-use-in-mexico-1.5293272 (CTV News)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 21 deaths in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll to 791. [https://www.thestar.com.my/news/nation/2021/02/02/health-ministry-3455-new-cases-21-fatalities (''The Star'')]
****Malaysia extends its [[Malaysian movement control order|movement control order]] in all states and territories except [[Sarawak]] until February 18. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/news/asia/malaysia-mco-2-0-extended-feb-5-feb-18-ismail-sabri-covid-19-14092872 (CNA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Indonesia]]
****[[Indonesia]] reports a record 12,848 recoveries in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of recoveries to 896,530. [https://health.detik.com/berita-detikhealth/d-5358407/pecah-rekor-12848-pasien-covid-19-sembuh-dalam-sehari-ini-sebarannya (detikHealth)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Japan]]
****The Japanese government extends an ongoing [[state of emergency]] in 10 [[Prefectures of Japan|prefectures]], including [[Tokyo]], which surpassed 100,000 cases yesterday. [https://www.upi.com/Top_News/World-News/2021/02/02/Japan-extends-state-of-emergency-amid-rising-COVID-19-cases/5091612276439/ (UPI)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Kyrgyzstan]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Kyrgyzstan]] is expected to receive 504,000 doses of the [[University of Oxford|Oxford]]-[[AstraZeneca]] [[Oxford-AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] in March. [https://24.kg/english/182075_Kyrgyzstan_to_receive_AstraZeneca_vaccine_in_March/ (24.kg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pakistan]]
****[[Prime Minister of Pakistan|Prime Minister]] [[Imran Khan]] launches the vaccination campaign against COVID-19 in [[Pakistan]], with the first dose of [[Sinopharm|Sinopharm's]] vaccine administered to a doctor in [[Islamabad]]. [https://www.dawn.com/news/1605089 (DAWN)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the State of Palestine]]
****[[Palestinian Authority]] begins a vaccination campaign against COVID-19 starting with [[healthcare workers]] in the occupied [[West Bank]]. [https://www.dailysabah.com/world/mid-east/covid-19-vaccination-campaign-kicks-off-in-occupied-palestine (''Daily Sabah'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Vietnam]], [[Variant of Concern 202012/01]]
****The [[Ministry of Health (Vietnam)|Ministry of Health]] confirms that 276 people in 10 provinces and cities are currently infected with the UK variant of SARS-CoV-2. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/world/2061399/vietnam-confirms-latest-virus-outbreak-is-more-contagious-uk-variant (''The Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 vaccine]]
***[[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine]]
****A [[peer-reviewed]] result published in the journal ''[[The Lancet]]'' finds [[Russia]]'s [[Sputnik V]] vaccine to be 91.6% effective against symptomatic COVID-19 infection. It is the third major vaccine candidate to exceed 90% efficacy, along with the [[Pfizer–BioNTech COVID-19 vaccine|Pfizer]] and [[Moderna COVID-19 vaccine|Moderna]] vaccines. [https://www.msn.com/en-us/news/technology/peer-reviewed-study-finds-russias-covid-vaccine-is-916-25-effective/ar-BB1djXUG?ocid=BingNews (CBS on MSN)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2021 Myanmar coup d'état]]
**[[China]] blocks a [[United Nations Security Council]] statement formally condemning the [[Tatmadaw|military]] coup in Myanmar. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-asia-55913947 (BBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 Sunrise, Florida shootout]]
**Two [[Federal Bureau of Investigation|FBI]] agents are killed and three others are wounded during a shootout in [[Sunrise, Florida|Sunrise]], [[Florida]], while serving an [[arrest warrant]]. The gunman is later found dead. This is the deadliest incident involving FBI agents since [[1986 FBI Miami shootout|1986]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-55908105 (BBC News)] [https://www.orlandosentinel.com/news/breaking-news/fl-ne-sunrise-fbi-shooting-reflections-20210202-v3hlzy2yynerhpn577quiuwroi-story.html (''Orlando Sentinel'')]
*[[2021 Muskogee shooting]]
**Five children and one adult are killed, and another person wounded, during a [[mass shooting]] at a home in [[Muskogee, Oklahoma]]. A 25-year-old male suspect who had been living with the victims is taken into custody. [https://apnews.com/article/muskogee-shootings-police-tulsa-oklahoma-3b7f0fb355d18a379ca5192d01e53cfc (Associated Press)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Cabinet of Joe Biden]]
**The [[United States Senate]] votes to confirm [[Pete Buttigieg]] as [[United States Secretary of Transportation|Transportation Secretary]], making him the first [[coming out|openly]] [[gay]] person to be confirmed to a [[Cabinet of the United States|Cabinet]] post. [https://abcnews.go.com/Politics/wireStory/senate-set-confirm-buttigieg-transportation-secretary-75626576 (ABC News)]
**The Senate also confirms [[Alejandro Mayorkas]] as [[United States Secretary of Homeland Security|Secretary of Homeland Security]], making him the first [[American Jews|Jewish]] person, first [[Hispanic and Latino Americans|Latino]] person and first [[immigration to the United States|immigrant]] to head the [[United States Department of Homeland Security|Department of Homeland Security]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/national-security/536896-senate-confirms-bidens-dhs-pick-after-gop-delay (''The Hill'')]
*[[2021 Italian government crisis]]
**[[President of Italy|President]] [[Sergio Mattarella]] invites former [[President of the European Central Bank]] [[Mario Draghi]] to form a new [[Government of Italy|government]] following the [[resignation]] of [[Giuseppe Conte]] as [[Prime Minister of Italy|Prime Minister]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2021/0202/1194674-italy/ (AFP via RTE)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020–21 Premier League]], [[Manchester United F.C. 9–0 Southampton F.C.]]
**[[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] defeats [[Southampton F.C.|Southampton]] 9–0 to equal the record for the [[List of Premier League highest scoring games#Biggest winning margin|largest winning margin]] in a [[Premier League]] match, equalling that of [[Leicester City F.C.|Leicester City]]'s [[Southampton F.C. 0–9 Leicester City F.C.|0–9 victory]] against the same team in [[2019–20 Premier League|the previous season]] and their own [[Manchester United F.C. 9–0 Ipswich Town F.C.|9–0 win]] against [[Ipswich Town F.C.|Ipswich Town]] in [[1994–95 FA Premier League|1995]]. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-02-03/manchester-united-smash-nine-man-southampton-9-0/13115834 (ABC Australia)]
